levels.surface: عثمان بن عبد الله بن موهب

notes: The last link is «يحدث عن أبيه»: the father of Abd Allah ibn Abi Qatada, a relation with no name in this text; the story («فرأيت حمار وحش») is his own account.
The people on the journey are in the scene only. The Prophet's answer is the saying and ends the chain.
